name: Multi-Retailer Buying Brief
description: Compare a required product query across Google Shopping Light, Amazon, and eBay using the active mode's configured location or postal code when supported, save an optional bounded Stash snapshot, and create a Canvas recommendation based on comparable price, delivery, rating, reviews, condition, and seller evidence. It does not purchase anything or fan out into product-detail requests.

steps.abort_speech: Buying brief requires a product query after the command, for example /buying_brief noise-canceling headphones.
steps.description: Search multi-retailer Google Shopping offers using configured localization
Search Amazon without per-product detail fan-out
Search eBay with the mode postal code as a shipping-area bias when configured

params.name: buying_brief_${filename_timestamp}.txt

steps.description: Optionally save the bounded comparison rows to Stash
Create the dated Canvas buying recommendation

success_speech: The multi-retailer buying brief for ${product} is ready in Canvas.
abort_speech: The buying brief could not be completed for ${topic}.
